intents.description: Read founder status and mint only the customer-requested paid buy-back checkout link.

intents.description: Collect exact account-state facts and hand off until login/email tools are exposed.

skills.activates_when: Submit structured action requests via ClickUp tasks for operations review
skills.name: action-request
skills.outcome: When a customer requests a write action (credit change, refund, profile update, dispute), the CS agent creates a structured ClickUp task tagged hydra-action-request in list 901000600160.

skills.activates_when: Preview which credits a customer wants off their own profile (read-only), then route them to remove it themselves in the app or file the packet; also detect mis-described unmerge requests and escalate them with audit context
skills.name: customer-credit-removal
skills.outcome: Two related customer requests, handled together:

skills.activates_when: When a customer asks about credits they submitted that are stuck in "user verification needed", confirm ownership with the read-only credit_verification_check tool, ask the customer for proof, and route the outcome.
skills.name: customer-credit-verification
skills.outcome: A customer is asking about credits they submitted that are stuck in user_verification_needed (UVN) – the backend flagged the claim as needing proof.

skills.activates_when: Use when a verified customer asks to claim/verify their profile and a pending claim exists on it.
skills.name: customer-profile-claim
skills.outcome: When a customer asks to claim/verify a profile that is theirs and a pending claim already exists on it, you can approve that claim yourself instead of handing off.

skills.activates_when: Merge a customer's OWN duplicate profiles into the profile they own – the SAFE self-service merge case, gated by the muso capability gate. The gate corroborates identity server-side (same or near-same name, the customer's own verified/pending claim, empty dup, or shared tracks) and refuses…
skills.name: customer-profile-consolidate
skills.outcome: When a customer has duplicate profiles – their real (claimed) profile plus duplicates that fragment their credits – you can fold the duplicates into the profile they own.

skills.activates_when: When a customer asks to merge/dedupe their duplicate Muso profiles, verify ownership with the read-only dedupe_check tool and file a high-signal profile-merge ticket for Operations.
skills.name: customer-profile-dedupe
skills.outcome: A customer says they have duplicate Muso profiles and wants them merged into one.

skills.activates_when: When a customer asks to merge/dedupe duplicate TRACKS (not profiles), capture which track to keep and which duplicate(s) to fold in, then file ONE high-signal track-merge ticket for the Catalog/Operations team.
skills.name: customer-track-dedupe
skills.outcome: A customer says the same recording appears as two (or more) tracks and wants the duplicates folded into one master.

skills.activates_when: Buy a milestone badge or plaque; verify profile and streams, then route pre-order corrections or existing-order issues.
skills.name: milestone-badge-purchase
skills.outcome: Buy a milestone badge or plaque; verify profile and streams, then route pre-order corrections or existing-order issues.

skills.activates_when: Handle plaque/poster order-fulfillment support – Prodigi vendor address-confirmation requests and customer order/shipping questions – by validating and reformatting the shipping address and filing a structured order-fulfillment request for the team to complete.
skills.name: order-fulfillment
skills.outcome: Muso sells physical acrylic plaques / posters; they're printed and shipped by a print-on-demand vendor, Prodigi.

skills.activates_when: 3-gate retention flow (50% save, free-plan fallback) before cancelling or escalating a refund
skills.name: refund-retention
skills.outcome: When a customer wants out – a refund request OR a cancellation request – Caroline runs this 3-gate retention flow BEFORE cancelling anything or creating a subscription-refund action-request ticket.

tools.resolves: muso subscription billing-summary --email <verified-email> --env prod --json (read-only; muso-cli >=0.10.0 -> GET /admin/team/:id/billing-summary).
